# Now playing sub-actions

## Get now playing

Looks at what song plays right now and saves it in variables. Use it for a !song command: add this step, then send "Now playing: %nowPlaying.title% by %nowPlaying.artist%".

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nowPlaying.title%` | The song's name (empty when nothing plays) |
| `%nowPlaying.artist%` | Who sings or plays it |
| `%nowPlaying.album%` | The album (empty when the player does not say) |
| `%nowPlaying.player%` | The player it plays in, like Spotify or VLC |
| `%nowPlaying.durationText%` | How long the song is, written like 3:45 |
| `%nowPlaying.link%` | A web link to the song (Spotify songs only) |
| `%nowPlaying.playing%` | True while it plays, False when it is paused |
| `%nowPlaying.found%` | True when a song was found, False when nothing plays (check it with an If step) |

<small>Type id: `nowplaying.get`</small>

## Media control

Presses a media button on your music player: play or pause, next song or previous song. Works with players on this computer and with Spotify.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Button** | Which button to press. "Play / pause" pauses when music plays and plays when it is paused. Options: Play / pause, Play, Pause, Next song, Previous song. Starts as: `Play / pause`. |
| **Player** | Which player to press it on: part of its name, like vlc or spotify. Leave it empty for the one that plays now. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nowPlaying.player%` | The player that got the button press |

<small>Type id: `nowplaying.mediaControl`</small>
